about_the_game:
Earthlings is a resource and time management game where you manage ancient workers under the rule of an anxious alien pretending to be a god. Meet G, a space delivery guy who accidentally landed on Earth and saw the opportunity of a lifetime. After seeing the amazing monuments humans built to worship him, he decided to exploit their creativity and sell their art as his own across the galaxy.

You're his unwilling project manager, and when deadlines slip, his anxiety triggers disasters.

He's your boss, your burden, and ultimately your enemy.

Enjoy Bossing Around!

Time to Grab & Drop! Constantly reassign your precious workers between gathering resources, defending against attacks, and building monuments before deadlines. Sometimes it's zen-like planning, other times pure firefighting. Things can slip out of control fast, so you'll have to stay sharp and adapt on the fly!

Design Crazy Monuments!

Deck-building Meets Resource Management! You read that right! Collect monument part cards, each with unique costs and game-changing effects - heal your workers, multiply reputation, boost production, and more. Before each level, select cards from your collection to define your strategy. Between levels, discover new cards or upgrade your favorites for enhanced powers. Cards with better effects require harder-to-get resources, so it won't be a walk in the park. Build your deck, choose your tactics, and turn crazy monuments into strategic advantages.

Upgrade and Handle Chaos Like a Pro!

Deadlines aren't suggestions! Miss them and your anxious overlord triggers sandstorms, enemy attacks, and supernatural disasters. Battle through hostile territories to claim rare resources and expand your reach. Turn earned knowledge into permanent upgrades that help you survive the mounting chaos. Keep growing stronger to handle whatever comes next!

Keep your workers moving. Create monuments strategically. Survive the pressure. Are you up for the challenge?

If so, please don't forget to wishlist Earthlings!
